text:
Rina V: Heads-up: proposing a hotpatch flow for small quant profile fixes (fp8/int8/4bit) so we can ship table tweaks without full profile rollouts. Wanted quick feedback.

Carlos M: Curious about API: do you expect hotpatches to be per-layer deltas or whole-table replacements?

Rina V: Per-layer deltas. Keep payloads tiny and allow skipping problematic layers. Hotpatch manifest contains layer ids, offsets, new entries, and a short reason string.

Helena J: How do we avoid breaking KV cache pointers during in-memory swaps? Past issues caused OOMs.

Tom K: Swap handshake: allocate new GPU buffer, prepare patches, atomically CAS pointer in runtime, then background free. Add check that active request count is below threshold before swap.

Carlos M: We need a safety net: run hotpatch in shadow mode for 10k tokens before committing. If degscore delta > 0.05 or hallucination signal spikes, abort.

Rina V: Agreed. Shadow window default 10k tokens; can be overridden per-tenant. Also plan a 0.2% live canary after shadow passes.

Helena J: Telemetry: record hotpatch_id, applied_layers, patch_size_bytes, shadow_ppl_delta, live_degscore. Sample diffs as hashes, never plaintext.

Tom K: Ops: add tenant flag precision.hotpatch_enabled = true|false. Default true for hosted, false for Dedicated/Private. Also add `precision.hotpatch_mode` = allow|shadow|disabled.

Carlos M: Rollback policy? Manual and automatic. Auto-rollback if moving-average degscore > 0.06 over 5k tokens or p99 latency > 1.6x baseline. Manual via `rwd-quant-hotpatch revert <id>`.

Rina V: UX: provide `rwd-quant-compare --base profileA --patch patch.bin --sample 1000 --jsonl` which runs shadow comparisons and prints short pass/fail reasons. Outputs jsonlines suitable for dashboards.

Helena J: Add preflight checks: patch syntactic validation, GPU memory check, quick perf microbenchmark, and a determinism smoke (replay 50 seeds).

Tom K: We'll automate the canary run and post results. ops-bot: schedule nightly canary job name `hotpatch-canary/1759998889`.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created: hotpatch-canary/1759998889. Results will post to #release-war-room.

Carlos M: Docs: include troubleshooting steps: if late-token drift observed, try skipping layer N via `--skip-layer N` or revert. Also include guidance on patch sizing and per-layer thresholds.

Rina V: Nice. Action items: I will draft hotpatch RFC with manifest schema; Tom will prototype atomic swap; Helena will add shadow harness; Carlos will wire dashboard ingestion. Sync Fri 11am.

Tom K: Prototype link in sandbox by EOD tomorrow.

Helena J: Shadow harness PR by Thursday.

Carlos M: Dashboard worktracked INF-HP-42.

Rina V: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
